         3       will come to order.  Ask the members to take

         8                      ACTING PRESIDENT KUHL:  We're

         9       joined by the Reverend Robert Hess from the

        10       Delmar Reformed Church in Delmar, New York, to

        11       deliver us a prayer.

        12                      REVEREND ROBERT HESS:  Let us

        13       pray.

        14                      Almighty God, another session for

        15       these elected men and women to make decisions,

        16       to take actions.  Help them to decide the better

        17       thing to do.  In difficulty, keep them from

        18       discouragement and, in failure, keep them from

        19       despair.  In joy, help them not to forget to

        20       sympathize with others who are sad and, in

        21       sorrow, help them to hope for the future as well

        22       as to remember the past.  In success, keep them

        23       from conceit and, when things go well, keep them











                                                             
2931

         1       from thinking they can do without You.  Help

         2       them to remember that there is no situation in

         3       which You cannot be present and no time in which

         4       they do not need Your help.  This is our prayer,

         5       O God.  Amen.
